title: Regional Publishing Product Lead - Riftbound
summary: 경력 8년 이상 · 서울 강남구. Develop and lead Riftbound's Korea publishing strategy in alignment with global product and publishing objecti
duties: Develop and lead Riftbound's Korea publishing strategy in alignment with global product and publishing objectives
Translate Korean player insights, cultural trends, and market dynamics into clear priorities and publishing plans
Oversee the execution of local marketing campaigns, community programs, competitive-play initiatives, and retail activations
Establish goals and success measures for the Korea market, and adjust plans based on performance and player feedback
Ensure local initiatives deliver a cohesive and culturally relevant Riftbound player experience
Manage, coach, and develop a team responsible for Riftbound publishing initiatives in Korea
Establish clear goals, roles, and ways of working that enable the team to operate effectively; provide regular feedback and support career development
Allocate team capacity and resources based on player needs, business priorities, and launch requirements
quals: 8+ years of experience in publishing, product management, marketing, or a related discipline within games, entertainment, consumer products, or another relevant industry
2+ years of experience directly managing and developing teams
Strong understanding of Korean consumer behavior, cultural trends, media channels, and gaming or entertainment audiences; experience launching or growing products in the Korean market
Experience leading complex, cross-functional programs involving multiple internal teams and external partners
Experience managing agencies, distributors, retailers, community organizations, or other commercial partners
Demonstrated ability to establish priorities, manage budgets, and use performance data to guide decisions
Fluency in Korean and English, both written and spoken
prefs: Experience in tabletop games, trading card games, hobby entertainment, organized play, or competitive gaming; existing relationships within Korea's TCG, gaming, retail, creator, or hobby ecosystems
Experience adapting global products, campaigns, or brands for the Korean market
Experience managing teams through a product launch or period of rapid growth
Familiarity with retail distribution, organized-play programs, inventory dependencies, or physical consumer products
Ability to convert player and market insights into clear strategies and executable plans; passion for tabletop and trading card games and empathy for Korean player communities
